title: 2005 iTest Problems/Problem 45
text:
Run the procedure below: 

1. Convert the x in f(x) to binary (you can get 10100 in this case)
2. Read the first digit in the binary (1 in this case), set S to it
3. Keep reading the digits in the binary (set b to the digit you're reading) and apply the ruleset below:
   a) if S ends with 0 or 1
      b = 0 -> append 0 to the end of S
      b = 1 -> append 2 to the end of S
   b) if S ends with 2
      b = 0 -> replace the 2 to 002 in the end of S
      b = 1 -> replace the 2 to  11 in the end of S
4. You'll eventually get the final S in the ternary form, convert it back to decimal. Then you will get the answer (in this case 731)
